title: follow-cam action spotting, pilot: a video action spotter trained on follow-cam crops of SoccerTrack v2
written: 2026-11-21, before any crop is generated or any model trained
owner request: 2026-11-21: 'lance la detection sur vue suivie simulee', pilot first (2 training matches, 1 validation match)
why a video model: shots_learn/diagnose: with the annotation ball, the trajectory spotter reaches whole-match precision 0.23 at recall 0.80, so a better ball (all a follow-cam could add to the current chain) cannot reach the bar; the follow-cam's lever is seeing the gestures, as in broadcast
data: SoccerTrack v2 v1.2 (CC BY 4.0), official split: training M3 118575 and M4 118576 (both halves), validation M2 117093 (both halves); M7 / M9 untouched
virtual camera (fixed, not tuned): per frame, centre = median image position (box centre) of the truth's players and goalkeepers (GSR boxes; no action enters the camera, so its motion cannot reveal when actions happen), interpolated, smoothed by a centred 2-s rolling median then a 1-s rolling mean; crop 0.35 x the panorama width, 16:9, clamped inside the image, scaled to 796 x 448 (the tdeed_probe camera with truth boxes instead of our detections); every 2nd frame (12.5 fps), H.264 CRF 20
labels: the 12 BAS classes of each half at their frames (T-DEED's SoccerNetBall label format, one video per half)
model: T-DEED architecture (github.com/arturxe2/T-DEED, GPL-3.0, commit d953b4d): rny002_gsf + ed_sgp_mixer, clip 100, stride 2, radi_displacement 4, mixup, the SoccerNetBall_challenge1 config otherwise; the RegNetY backbone from timm's ImageNet weights; NO SoccerNet weights (NDA) and no pretraining head
budget: one timing run (1 short epoch, speed only, no score read), then the pilot training on Kaggle T4 with num_epochs and epoch_num_frames set from that speed to fit <= 6 h of training; model kept = last epoch (no selection on M2)
evaluation (M2, both halves, whole video: per-frame class scores with T-DEED's video inference (clip 100, stride 2); per class, detections = local maxima of the score (1-s non-maximum suppression); a detection matches an unmatched true action of its class within 2 s; event AP per class; the random baseline = AP of uniform random scores (mean of 20 draws); for shots (SHOT + GOAL scores, matched to SHOT or GOAL), precision at recall 0.60 and 0.80 over the match
gate for the full run (fixed now): learning signal: SHOT AP >= 5 x its random AP and PLAYER SUCCESSFUL TACKLE AP >= 5 x its random AP on M2; reported beside it, not gating: shots precision at recall 0.60 against the v4 trajectory spotter's whole-match 0.21 (shots_learn/negatives, a different unit), and PASS AP
caveats (stated now): a camera that follows the players' median, wider than Veo's (0.35 of the panorama); detail no finer than the panorama (upscaled when zoomed); one validation match (~25 shots, ~20 tackles), so APs are noisy
